(b) FAILURE MODE: capacity-bound -- tv_share_steps=True gives only 2 trainable scalars (one step + one lambda); the K=8 global-TV chain converges to a near-identity map on the LD-FBP init -> SSIM pinned at the FBP-passthrough floor ~0.8192, recon PSNR 33.597 BELOW the HD-FBP baseline -> hr structurally clamps to 0. A single global TV weight is a structurally weak image-domain prior vs real 2304-view LDCT noise. (c) LEVER MAP EXHAUSTED (verified from cfg history): tv_step_init {1e-2 saturate SSIM 0.28 / 1e-8 passthrough / 1e-5 active-basin} bracketed; tv_share_steps {F per-step runaway SSIM 0.61-0.69 / T stable}; lr {5e-2 over-drives lambda / 5e-3 stable}; tv_K {30 inert frozen-step, 30/10->8 flat stable -- the itnet/hammernik_vn depth-DOWN breakout analog TRIED and FAILED}; train_n {40 base / 160 SSIM 0.8186 slightly worse -> CAPACITY-bound not data-bound}; seed {+-4e-6 robust}. (d) DECISION: epochs=8 is the ONLY never-varied lever, REVISITED and re-rejected: the 2-scalar share=True fit has already converged (iters 9-16 bit-identical -> loss flat, lambda settled); more epochs re-converge the SAME identity map, cannot add capacity, cannot manufacture headroom against a functional-form ceiling. The only ceiling-breaking change (per-pixel TV weights / adjoint normalization) lives in the FORBIDDEN ddssl_ldct solver, outside the config contract. So empty-patch {} is correct -- no in-budget config-only lever can move hr off 0. (e) BUDGET: reproduces iter-7 -> 211-274s measured iters 10-16, >900s margin under 1200s wall. (f) BASE_ITER=7 hr-best/max-SSIM canonical stable. PREDICTED iter-17: SSIM ~0.8192 +-0.001, hr 0.0 -- clean documentation of the supervised-unrolled-TV FBP-ceiling toward the iter-20 hard stop (9th identical confirm).
